language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the display language for the app interface. More languages can be added by the community.

network.title: Network Selection
network.description: Switching networks requires a full restart. Each network uses a separate chain data directory.
network.stopNodeHint: Stop the node before switching networks.
network.confirmMessage: Switching to {{network}} will stop all node services and re-sync from scratch on the new network. This may take a long time and any pending operations will be interrupted.
network.confirmDescription: Each network uses its own chain data directory. Your wallet and settings are preserved.
network.switchedToastBody: All node services stopped. Start the node to sync the new network.

wallet.copyAddressFailedBody: Could not copy address to clipboard.
wallet.managementDescription: Manage your wallet's UTxO set for optimal transaction building.
wallet.nodeMustBeSynced: Node must be synced to analyze wallet health.
wallet.collateralTooltip: A dedicated 5 ADA UTxO required by Cardano for Plutus script transactions. It is returned to you if the transaction succeeds.
wallet.previewCapped: Limited to first 200 UTxOs. Run again to continue.
wallet.collateralExplainer: Collateral is a small ADA deposit (5 ADA) required by Cardano smart contracts for transaction validation.
wallet.optimizationTooltip: Combines multiple small UTxOs into fewer, larger ones. This reduces transaction complexity and fees.
wallet.optimizationHint: Optimization combines small UTxOs into fewer, larger ones to reduce transaction fees.
wallet.walletOptimizedDescription: Consolidated UTxOs for optimal transaction building
wallet.confirmCollateralMessage: This will create a dedicated 5 ADA collateral UTxO by sending ADA to yourself. Collateral is required for all Plutus script transactions (listings, bids, etc.).
wallet.confirmCollateralDescription: A transaction fee (~0.2 ADA) will be deducted. You need at least 6.5 ADA total in your wallet.
wallet.confirmDefragMessage_one: This will consolidate your {{count}} UTxO into an optimized set for efficient transaction building.
wallet.confirmDefragMessage_other: This will consolidate your {{count}} UTxOs into an optimized set for efficient transaction building.
wallet.confirmDefragDescription: All UTxOs will be consumed and new ones created in a single transaction. A transaction fee (~0.2 ADA) will be deducted.
wallet.recoveryDescription: View your 24-word recovery phrase. You will need to re-enter your password.
wallet.autoLockDescription: Automatically lock the wallet after a period of inactivity.
wallet.lockWalletDescription: Lock your wallet to require password entry before using it again.

dataLayer.iagonDescription: Connect your Iagon account to upload and download files for non-text listings. Your wallet signature is used for authentication — no passwords needed.
dataLayer.connectedSubtitle: API key stored securely. File categories are available.
dataLayer.notConnectedSubtitle: Connect to enable file uploads (document, audio, image, video).
dataLayer.accountRequirementBody: You need an Iagon account with active storage. Visit
dataLayer.accountRequirementBodyAfter: to create one, then return here to connect.
dataLayer.unlockFirstHint: Unlock your wallet first to connect to Iagon.
dataLayer.manualKeyDescriptionBefore: If wallet signing doesn't work, paste your API key from
dataLayer.storageUsageDescription: Total encrypted data stored on Iagon across all your files.
dataLayer.storageUsageKeyMissing: Iagon API key is not accessible. Reconnect to refresh usage.
dataLayer.orphanedDescription: Files uploaded to Iagon whose listing transactions failed or were abandoned.
dataLayer.orphanedPartialBody: Deleted {{succeeded}} of {{total}} files. {{failed}} could not be removed.
dataLayer.orphanedFailedBody: Could not delete any orphaned files. Check your internet connection.
dataLayer.confirmDisconnectMessage: This will remove your Iagon API key. You won't be able to upload or download files until you reconnect.
dataLayer.confirmDisconnectDescription: You'll need to re-authenticate with your wallet before uploading files again.
dataLayer.confirmDeleteAllMessage_one: Delete {{count}} orphaned file from Iagon? This cannot be undone.
dataLayer.confirmDeleteAllMessage_other: Delete all {{count}} orphaned files from Iagon? This cannot be undone.
dataLayer.howItWorks1: Your wallet signs a message to authenticate with Iagon (CIP-8).
dataLayer.howItWorks2: A persistent API key is generated and stored encrypted on disk.
dataLayer.howItWorks3: When you create a file listing, the encrypted file is uploaded to Iagon.
dataLayer.howItWorks4: Buyers download and decrypt using their own Iagon connection.
dataLayer.howItWorksFooterBefore: Requires an Iagon account with storage. Visit
dataLayer.connectFailedSuffix: . You can paste your API key from app.iagon.com below instead.
dataLayer.verifyInvalid: API key is no longer valid. Please reconnect.
dataLayer.manualKeyInvalid: API key is invalid or expired. Check your key and try again.

logs.developerModeDescription: Show detailed runtime information for debugging.

automation.title: Automation
automation.autoAcceptTooltip: When enabled, bids at or above your suggested price are automatically accepted. The oldest eligible bid is processed first. SNARK proofs generate in the background (~3 min each).
automation.autoAcceptExplainer: Automatically accepts pending bids where the bid amount meets or exceeds your listing's suggested price. Only processes one bid at a time. Manually accepted bids get priority in the queue.
automation.howItWorks1: 1. A bid arrives at or above your suggested price
automation.howItWorks2: 2. The bid is added to the processing queue (oldest first)
automation.howItWorks3: 3. A SNARK proof is generated in the background (~3 min)
automation.howItWorks4: 4. The proof + re-encryption transactions are submitted on-chain
automation.viewQueueAfter: tab. Failed items can be retried from there.

preferences.notifDurationDescription: How long toast notifications stay visible before auto-dismissing.
preferences.desktopNotifDescription: Show system notifications when new bids arrive on your listings.
preferences.notifSoundsDescription: Play sounds for bids, transactions, and other events.
